summary.intent: Execute Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning) to add Grafana alert rules and tune client timeouts/retries, then get the PR reviewed and merged.
summary.outcome: Phase 26 fully executed and merged to main — 5 Grafana alert rule JSONs, a provisioning script, Alloy metric filtering, HTTP route cardinality capping, and timeout/retry tuning across 5 files. PR #366 passed 14/14 verification must-haves and all CI checks after fixing stale test assertions.

repo: Phase 26 branch was created from main before PRs #360, #361, #363 landed — the 'unrelated changes' in the diff were main moving ahead, not stray commits. A rebase/merge was needed before PR.

The GSD tools (gsd-tools.cjs) must be run from the correct working directory — running from cipher-box (not cipher-box-ci-debug) caused the 'no plans found' false error on first execute-phase attempt.

Grafana Cloud Free tier has a 10,000 active series limit — Kubo and Someguy IPFS nodes export massive cardinality (DHT, bitswap per-peer, libp2p protocol metrics) and were the likely cause of hitting the limit.
The dashboard only uses 6 external metrics from Kubo/Someguy: go_goroutines, go_memstats_alloc_bytes, libp2p_swarm_connections_opened/closed_total, libp2p_network_in/out_bytes_total.

The merge resolution for ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, and REQUIREMENTS.md took the branch version which predated Phase 24/25 completions on main — 7 planning doc inconsistencies had to be manually fixed post-merge.
Merging main into the feature branch is better than rebasing here — the GSD planning docs have frequent conflicts that need careful resolution to preserve both phase histories.

code.finding: NestJS registers full flat routes (not fragments) — req.route.path already includes the controller prefix, so Copilot's complaint about missing prefix was incorrect.
Tests asserted old baseDelayMs of 1000ms — after Phase 26 tuned it to 500ms, three test assertions failed CI (expected 1000/2000/1000, needed 500/1000/500).
Alert was using wrong metric — should track cipherbox_ipns_resolves_total{source='db_cache'} not a delegated routing fallback counter.
Both p95 and p99 PromQL expressions were missing result='success' label filter, causing the histogram to include failed pin attempts in latency calculations.
Usage header showed 2 positional args but code expected 3 — caused by iterating review cycles. Arg mapping was also wrong after the idempotent upsert refactor.
Added prometheus.relabel filter stage to whitelist only 6 used metrics from Kubo/Someguy scrapes before remote_write, eliminating thousands of unused series.
Unmatched routes (bot scanners hitting /wp-admin, /.env etc.) were creating unique histogram label values — collapsed to /:unmatched to cap cardinality.

workflow: The GSD execute-phase workflow correctly handles the case where plans don't exist yet — it errors with a clear message and suggests /gsd:plan-phase.
Running /gsd:plan-phase when plans already exist correctly detects them and skips to the offer_next step without replanning.
The Grafana series limit issue surfaced organically during Phase 26 and was fixed within the same PR — a good example of in-scope scope expansion.
Iterative PR review resolution (3 separate resolve-comments invocations) is expected — automated reviewers (Copilot, CodeRabbit) post new comments as each push triggers re-review.
Documentation-only review comments from Copilot on planning files (.planning/) are consistently not worth fixing — they misunderstand the GSD workflow artifact structure.

friction: First execute-phase invocation failed because gsd-tools ran against the wrong working directory (cipher-box vs cipher-box-ci-debug) — the phase directory existed but the tool couldn't find it.
Merge conflict resolution for planning docs (ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, REQUIREMENTS.md) silently dropped Phase 24 and 25 completion marks — required manual inspection and repair across 3 files.
CI failed immediately after merge due to delegated-routing.client.spec.ts assertions that were never updated when baseDelayMs was tuned from 1000→500ms.
The provision-alerts.sh script accumulated arg-mapping inconsistencies across multiple review cycles, requiring a dedicated fix pass.
CodeRabbit and Copilot generate substantial noise on planning documentation files (.planning/phases/) that always need to be dismissed as 'not applicable'.
open_items: The 5 Grafana alert JSON files (~877 lines total) have heavy structural duplication — a config table + template approach would significantly reduce this but was deferred as out of scope.
5s delegated routing timeout (tuned from 10s) may be aggressive under load since delegated-ipfs.dev is an external DHT-backed service — worth monitoring after deploy.
The ipHash: '' empty string in existing code fails strict 64-char hex validation — flagged but not fixed as it predates Phase 26 work.
PR #365 (fix/recovery-e2e-kubo-ipns) had a valid nitpick comment at pullrequestreview-4010875870 that was interrupted before being applied.
